title: Canonical bounded-below derived adjunction and its comparison normalization
statement:
Let $\mathcal B,\mathcal A$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] in a common universe [def-weil-size-convention], with derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and bounded-below derived categories [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories]. Assume $\mathcal A$ has enough injectives [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Let $L:\mathcal B\to\mathcal A$ and $R:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be additive functors with a specified adjunction $L\dashv R$, unit $\eta$ and counit $\varepsilon$, and assume $L$ is exact. Write $K^+(\mathcal E)$ for the homotopy category of bounded-below cochain complexes of $\mathcal E$, $q_{\mathcal E}:K^+(\mathcal E)\to D^+(\mathcal E)$ for localization at quasi-isomorphisms, and $K(F)$ for termwise application of $F$ on these homotopy categories. Let $L_D=D(L)$ with its exact-localization isomorphism $\phi_{L,N}:L_D(q_{\mathcal B}N)\xrightarrow{\sim}q_{\mathcal A}K(L)N$ [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization], and let $R^+=\mathbf R R$ with its natural right-derived comparison $\alpha_P:q_{\mathcal B}K(R)P\to R^+(q_{\mathcal A}P)$ [lem-weil-pbc-right-derived-plus-injective]. Then there is a canonical adjunction $L_D\dashv R^+$ whose unit $\eta^D$ and counit $\varepsilon^D$ satisfy, for all $N\in K^+(\mathcal B)$ and $P\in K^+(\mathcal A)$,
$$R^+(\phi_{L,N})\circ\eta^D_{q_{\mathcal B}N}=\alpha_{K(L)N}\circ q_{\mathcal B}(\eta^K_N),$$
$$\varepsilon^D_{q_{\mathcal A}P}\circ L_D(\alpha_P)=q_{\mathcal A}(\varepsilon^K_P)\circ\phi_{L,K(R)P},$$
where $\eta^K,\varepsilon^K$ are the homotopy classes of the termwise unit and counit. No enough-injectives hypothesis on $\mathcal B$ is required.
